gloss: ability to fall asleep; sleep onset

definitions.gloss: the ability or ease of falling asleep
definitions.explanation: describes how quickly and easily one can fall asleep

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{寝|ね}つき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If I drink coffee, I have trouble falling asleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寝|ね}つき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Stress made it harder for me to fall asleep.

notes:
SLEEP VOCABULARY:
{寝|ね}つき is the nominalized form of {寝|ね}つく (to fall asleep). It describes one's general ability to fall asleep.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {寝|ね}つき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/よい - to fall asleep easily
- {寝|ね}つき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - to have difficulty falling asleep
- {寝|ね}つき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - for sleep onset to improve

RELATED SLEEP WORDS:
- ⟦{寝覚|ねざ}め→寝覚め：08549_nezame⟧ - quality of waking up
- ⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧ - sleep
- ⟦{不眠|ふみん}→不眠：11078_fumin⟧ - insomnia
- ⟦{熟睡|じゅくすい}→熟睡：11079_jukusui⟧ - deep sleep

CONTRAST WITH {寝覚|ねざ}め:
- {寝|ね}つき - how well you fall asleep
- ⟦{寝覚|ねざ}め→寝覚め：08549_nezame⟧ - how well you wake up
